    Account & sync

    Local mode. Hosted accounts are not connected.

    Available when the included backend is running. Sync is explicit so one device does not silently overwrite another.

    3-day free trial · proposed plan
    $5.99 / month after trial
    • A daily outfit inspired by your style
    • A library of saved looks
    • Feedback to refine your recommendations
    • Daily check-ins and streak milestones

    The proposed membership starts with a 3-day free trial, followed by $5.99/month. Billing, fresh daily content, and secondhand shopping links are not connected. Exploring this prototype does not start a trial or charge you.

    The local demo lasts 72 hours. No payment details, charges, or automatic subscription are collected. Production checkout would show the billing date and cancellation terms before consent.

    Prototype feedback is stored locally, not used by a recommendation model. Three editorial samples demonstrate the experience.
